clusters.mechanism: An exception thrown by classifyCi escapes record() unhandled, so it aborts the repository's observation loop and starves every later PR.
The main-red branch records the failure and continues before fetching the job and logs, so the ledger signature has no log line or runner image.
The check_run_url comparison against the stored repository slug is case-sensitive, so valid canonical casing throws 'Incomplete failing job' and blocks the rerun.
A completed rerun with a skipped (or other non-success/bad) conclusion is never resolved, so the row stays rerunning and CI stays pending.
A rerun_requested row whose POST response was lost is not reconciled, so a later pass or fail is mislabelled or never recorded as a flake.
Rerun-job reconciliation searches only the workflow's latest attempt, so a job rerun in an earlier attempt has no match and classification throws.
The ci.main_red notification key includes the check name, so it is not deduplicated at repository scope.
PR failures suppressed by a red main are not resumed when main recovers, because classification is skipped while the PR's GraphQL state is unchanged.
Fail-fast matrix cancellations are treated as transient failures, rerun, and recorded as false flake evidence.
A rerun is requested while the workflow run is still in progress and GitHub rejects it, but the rerun cap is already spent.
The change is about twice the requested source-line budget, with dense defensive classifier code.
A column is added by a second migration to a table created in the same unreleased change, instead of being part of the CREATE TABLE.
Fetching job logs may forward the bearer token across a cross-host redirect (unverified).
Outstanding reruns beyond the 100-context GraphQL page are not reconciled, because ciKey does not change.
An existing, unchanged restart-repair test fails because its polling window expires before the pause callback is observed.
The OPEN-only guard skips classification of pr.ci_failed events on closed tracked PRs.
The feed excerpt is the first 2000 characters of the job log (runner preamble), not the failure.
The new [github] ci_reruns config switch is not documented in the GUIDE.
The failure signature takes the first log line matching fail/error, which is often an echoed action input rather than the real failure.
The main-red state resets while main's newest commit is still running checks, so a duplicate ci.main_red item is emitted when it finishes red again.
record() now returns early when the head epoch refuses an observation, so merges, closes and comments are dropped instead of the snapshot still being saved.
